body:
## Scope
- WI-1052: generate an identity-bound pending amendment-review request before verification; no automatic human approval.
- #1004: recover exact historical closeout across checkouts with raw Contract binding, CLI/MCP adapters, non-destructive pending/retry, and postcommit read-only recheck. A published canonical path is never unlinked by failure handling.
- Strict 1.0.1-rc.2 prerelease source/version validation for Apple Silicon macOS; stable installation and GitHub Latest remain v1.0.0. No tag or Release is created by this PR.

## Governance and limits
WI-1055 Runtime scaffold remains not_ready. Runtime rejected start because of archived WI-1042/WI-1043 scope conflicts. The user-authorized bounded bootstrap exception and actual rejection are recorded in docs/work-items/WI-1055-v1-0-1-bounded-hotfix.md; this PR does not claim Runtime admission, formal verification, historical WI closure, or human review. Old WI-1053 active records were not imported.
With a cross-checkout recovery receipt present, status checks its bound files and archive manifest before projecting closed. If that sole receipt is later deleted, the existing historical close format cannot distinguish the recovered close from an ordinary close. This residual risk is explicit; do not infer that arbitrary evidence deletion is detectable. A status projection is not independent verification proof.

## Verification
- Local cargo test --locked --workspace --quiet passed on the combined functional source before final rustfmt-only formatting; exact final head is for hosted CI to prove.
- Local cargo fmt --all -- --check, cargo clippy --locked --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings, tests/docs/documentation_acceptance.sh, tests/release/version_consistency.sh --repo ., and workflow convergence passed.
- Focused red/green regressions cover path-based rollback removal, same-byte retry, precommit payload deletion, postcommit status failure, receipt-bound payload loss, and prerelease drift/invalid syntax/stable misprojection.
- Prior head 42ba6e83 CI failed; its logs drove the targeted fixes. Its results and Mac artifact do not validate this head. Windows fixture now pins core.autocrlf=false to preserve exact-byte identity; new Windows CI is required.
- Sentinel exact-scope preflight no longer reports scope_exceeded while six recovered files remain, but identity-bound human review is pending, so downstream verification is not claimed.

Issue: #1004
title: fix: bounded closeout recovery and review-request admission (v1.0.1-rc.2)
